_READ_ME: SBFFC leaderboard settings. Every setting is explained in docs/SETTINGS.md. Only change the values after the colons; keep the quotes, commas and brackets exactly as they are. Lines starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
title: SBFFC Championship
_sample_mode: true = show the made-up sample season (the page says SAMPLE DATA). Change to false once all 23 Sleeper league IDs below are filled in.
_divisions: One entry per division. Paste each Sleeper league ID between the quotes (it is the long number in the league's web address: sleeper.com/leagues/THIS-NUMBER). The name is what the page shows.
_wildcards: Wild card = a team in the top wildcard_percent of ALL teams by total points through wildcard_lock_week that did not qualify through its division. No backfill, so the count varies.
_week12_final: Set to true once Week 12 stat corrections are final, to lock the wild-card count right away (it also locks on its own once Week 13 scores start).
_wildcard_tie_ruling: Only used when the page says 'points tie at the cutoff'. Put exact team names in quotes, e.g. "add": ["Bluegrass Mafia"]. add = make this team a wild card; remove = take this team out of the wild cards.
_weeks: SBFFC season calendar (NFL week numbers). Only change if the league changes its format.
_final_through_week: Optional. The last week whose stat corrections are final, e.g. 15. Leave null until then. Shown on the page.
status_note: Scores are unofficial until NFL stat corrections are final (typically by Thursday).

tiebreak_notes.division_seeding: Division seeds: best record, then total points, then head-to-head among the tied teams (SBFFC rules).
tiebreak_notes.division_playoff_game: Division playoff game tied on points: the higher seed advances (assumption - commissioner to confirm).
tiebreak_notes.championship_total: Championship total tied: teams share the rank; no published tiebreaker (commissioner to confirm).
tiebreak_notes.wildcard_cutoff: Points tie at the top-15% wild-card cutoff: commissioner ruling, entered in wildcard_tie_ruling.

_display: timezone = how update times are shown (America/Chicago = Central, America/New_York = Eastern). prize_places = how many places are highlighted as paid. auto_refresh_seconds = how often an open page re-checks for new scores.
_public_url: The web address where this page is published. Update it if the repo moves (e.g. https://sbffc.github.io/sbffc-leaderboard/) or you add a custom domain (e.g. https://leaderboard.sbffc.com/). Used to build the Squarespace snippet.
